technology_name: Smart Speed Display Boards for Safer Roads at Critical Locations
institution: KSCSTE - National Transportation Planning and Research Centre (NATPAC)
problem_solved: Rising road accidents at black spots and critical curves driven by overspeeding and a lack of real-time driver velocity feedback.
description: A system deployment and behavioral study of Dynamic Speed Display Boards (DSDBs) that provide real-time speed feedback to passing drivers. The system's efficacy is anchored in a psychological behavioral framework analyzed using a Structural Equation Model (SEM). The model establishes that a driver's Attitude towards DSDB (ATD), Subjective Norms (SBN), and Perceived Behavioural Control (PBC) strongly drive the Intention (INT) to slow down, directly translating to measurable Speed Reduction Behaviour (SPR) at accident-prone locations.
applications:
• Smart highway networks, sharp curves, and high-risk accident black spots

• School zones, hospital corridors, and pedestrian-heavy urban intersections

• Municipal traffic calming initiatives and smart-city speed enforcement networks

• Telematics data collection for highway planning and safety optimization
